authority: Line owner 2026-10-22: Twelve Gazes E01 viewer review — camera work and cuts do not follow how people watch films (forced motion, mechanical direction alternation, scripted cuts rendered as drifts, no shot-scale grammar).
activation_note: Never retroactive. An episode is under this policy only when its generation contract declares camera_grammar_policy=CAMERA_GRAMMAR_V1 (storyclaw_writer_workflow finalize stamps it on every contract sealed from this engine version on, unless the writer declared another value) or the episode is listed in enabled_episodes. Contracts sealed before this change carry no field and keep the old rules byte for byte. camera_grammar_policy=LEGACY_FORCED_MOTION is an explicit opt-out.

rules.no_new_blocking_check: Line owner 2026-10-22: quality comes from writer/director guidance and the provider prompt, not from more gates. This policy only relaxes or advises; it adds no blocking check and no required field.
rules.motivated_motion: static_design_gate: the forced-motion rules R1-R4/R6/R7 are REPORT_ONLY for these episodes (only R5/R8 still block). A LOCKED or slow DOLLY PUSH_IN no-dialogue shot is fine; camera_plan.motion_motivation (FOLLOW_SUBJECT | REVEAL | EMPHASIS | SUBJECTIVE) is optional.
rules.no_mechanical_alternation: build_nalu_preproduction stamps camera_plan.camera_grammar=CAMERA_GRAMMAR_V1; grouped_camera_contract.validate_camera_sequence then drops the adjacent-direction and five-unit direction caps for those plans. The pre-existing identical family+direction repeat check stays.
rules.real_cuts: A unit whose incoming boundary is an authored cut (internal_transition_authoring transition_mode in cut_transition_modes) or a scene/location change starts from its own keyframe instead of the previous unit's real tail (build_keyframe_manifest.derived_opener_shot_ids); continuous transitions keep the tail chain. Existing gates unchanged.
rules.shot_scale_grammar: Writer guidance plus REPORT_ONLY notes R10 (establishing framing within the first 2 shots of a new location), R11 (more than 2 consecutive shots at one shot_scale), R12 (listener without reaction shot), R9 (move without stated motivation), R13 (identical move twice).
rules.prompt: h3_provider_prompt_renderer adds a short film-grammar clause to stamped camera plans: locked = a still, composed frame with no drift; moving = a motivated move that starts with the action and settles on the end framing.
rules.previs: The zero-credit episode previs runs at S5/S6 for these episodes with machine_failure_mode ADVISORY: it records findings and the director-review questions but never blocks and never regenerates.
